  - text: CLASS 9 · REAL NUMBERS
  - heading "Rational and Irrational Classification" [level=1]
  - paragraph: "Objective: Classify real numbers as rational or irrational using exact definitions and representations."
  - text: ◷ 18 min ▥ INTERMEDIATE CONCEPT ♙ Real Numbers

    - paragraph: Drag each number card into the correct region. Then open its evidence panel and select the correct justification.
    - button "Reset all":
      - img
      - text: Reset all
    - paragraph: "Rational: can be written as p/q, where p, q are integers and q ≠ 0."
    - paragraph: "Irrational: decimal form is non-terminating and non-recurring."
    - article:
      - heading "RATIONAL NUMBERS" [level=2]
      - paragraph: Can be written as p/q, (q ≠ 0)
      - img
      - strong: Drop rational number cards here
    - article:
      - heading "IRRATIONAL NUMBERS" [level=2]
      - paragraph: Decimal is non-terminating and non-recurring
      - img
      - strong: Drop irrational number cards here
    - heading "DRAG THESE NUMBER CARDS" [level=3]
    - button "⠿ √2"
    - button "⠿ π"

    - heading "▣ EVIDENCE PANEL (SELECT A CARD ABOVE)" [level=3]
    - text: ★ Evidence required for full credit
    - paragraph: Open the panel for any placed card to see and choose the correct justification.
    - 'button "FRACTION FORM Can be written exactly as p/q, where p, q are integers and q ≠ 0. Example: 0.375 = 3/8" [disabled]'
    - 'button "TERMINATING/RECURRING DECIMAL Decimal terminates or repeats in a pattern. Example: 0.2727… = 3/11" [disabled]'
    - 'button "NON-REPEATING DECIMAL Decimal is non-terminating and non-recurring. Examples: √2, π" [disabled]'
    - img
    - text: Great! Start by sorting a number card.
    - emphasis: 0 correct
    - emphasis: 0 incorrect
    - emphasis: 8 remaining
    - article:
      - heading "WHY IT WORKS" [level=2]
      - paragraph: Rational numbers can be counted or measured with a finite or repeating decimal.
      - paragraph: Irrational numbers cannot be expressed as p/q and their decimals go on forever without repeating.
      - text: ←●—●—●—●—●—●—●→ ● Rational ● Irrational
    - article:
      - heading "▣ WORKED EXAMPLE" [level=2]
      - paragraph: Classify √2 and 0.375.
      - text: "Solution:"
      - paragraph: √2 is irrational because its decimal form is non-terminating, non-recurring.
      - paragraph: 0.375 = 375/1000 = 3/8, so it is rational.
      - strong: "Result: √2 is irrational; 0.375 is rational."
    - article:
      - heading "⚠ COMMON MISCONCEPTION" [level=2]
      - text: Every non-terminating decimal is not irrational; recurring decimals are rational.
      - paragraph: 0.272727… = 0.27̅ = 27/99 = 3/11 is rational, even though it goes on forever.
